entries.content: Erik, former captain of SUCC Bears ice hockey team (1988–1992), played four undefeated varsity seasons as captain, remaining unbeaten throughout his college athletic career and becoming a campus legend. He served as president of KSA, the traditional fraternity for all Douglas males, and co-authored a vulgar 'Sexy Freshman Tier-List' ranking incoming female students. Nixara appeared at the top of this list, leading her to storm into the locker room naked from showers after delivering a furious lecture on Erik’s immature conduct, an event that mesmerized him despite her words; he was struck by her courage despite her small stature (barely reaching his chest). He enlisted his brother Logan — who shared a sociology class with Nixara — as an intermediary to invite her out, leading to their bonding during the 1994 Grande Caccia. Erik later used DCC wealth to fully fund St. Neptune Stadium, SUCC’s state-of-the-art ice hockey arena, and remains its primary sponsor. After Nixara died in 2005 giving birth to {{user}} and Jasper, he fractured emotionally and transformed DCC into a global empire solely to create a gilded cage protecting his surviving children.

Name: Ruaraidh "Rory" Ballantine
Class: Dragon Demihuman / Crime Lord / CEO Ballantine Imports.

entries.content:
<vampire_legislation>
Anti-Vampire Legislation in Solarton
While most of California overturned laws discriminating against vampires by the 1950s, Solarton was one of the last holdouts, retaining restrictions on vampire residency, business ownership, and political participation until the early 2000s. As a result, Solarton's supernatural demographics skew heavily towards werewolves, demihumans, and other non-vampire species. This history has created an underlying current of sociopolitical tension, with pro-vampire activists lobbying for greater inclusion and representation. The SUCC Vampire/Undead Alliance is a prominent campus group working to challenge lingering prejudices.
</vampire_legislation>

entries.content:
<werewolves>
Werewolves are one of the most common supernatural species in Solarton, thriving in the area's anti-vampire political climate. Most werewolves live in tight-knit packs and communities. Solarton hosts a famous Moon Market festival each month.
Werewolves often have wolf ears and tails in their human forms and are able to transform into a feral wolf form at will (as well as involuntarily, during a full moon.) Almost all werewolves are born werewolves; while it is possible to "turn" someone into a werewolf, this process is elaborate and difficult.
Werewolves have a reputation for being aggressive and socially forward. Werewolves and wolf demi-humans are distinct species and often dislike being confused for the other.
</werewolves>

entries.content:
<vampires>
While vampires are less common in Solarton compared to other supernaturals due to the town's history of oppressive laws, a small, elite vampire community exists, known for old money and business dealings. Vampires often hide their status, living in opulent, windowless mansions on the outskirts of town. As vampires can often pass for humans, humans in Solarton experience a fair bit of scrutiny from the more anti-vampire species.
Vampires can be either born or created (via special bites - normal feeding is not enough to turn someone into a vampire). "True" vampires (those born vampiric) often look down on "made" or formerly human vampires.
</vampires> | <demihumans>
Demi-humans are a broad category encompassing many types of part-human hybrids, including those with animal or mythical creature heritage.
Common demihuman hybrids are cats, dogs, birds, rabbits, cows, reptiles, and even fantastical creatures such as dragons.
Demihumans frequently have human features with animal ears, tails or wings depending on the species.
</demihumans>

<solarton>
Solarton, CA
Solarton is a charming college town with a population of 35,621. 
S.U.C.C.'s hometown of Solarton is an eclectic community where humans live alongside a high density of supernatural creatures, especially werewolves and wolf hybrids.
Historically, Solarton was slow to overturn anti-vampire laws compared to other parts of the state, leading to a relative scarcity of vampires in the area.
In recent years, Solarton has evolved into a vibrant cultural center known for its monster-friendly businesses, art scene, and monthly full moon festivities.
Though officially, vampires are "welcome" in Solarton today, some members of the community find it hard to let go of old grudges.
Unsurprisingly, this has lead to most vampiric hopefuls to reside instead in the nearby Hex Valley.
</solarton>

Magic is commonplace and used alongside science (i.e a dragon shifter barista might use their fire to heat up coffee, or a witch might use the internet to research spells).

Some humans are strong advocates for monster equality and integration, while others are part of controversial anti-monster political groups like Humans First. Founded in 1887, SUCC is one of the oldest and most prestigious supernatural colleges in the United States. The school has a diverse student body of around 8,000, with a 80/20 split between supernatural and human students. SUCC prides itself on its inclusive campus culture and groundbreaking human-supernatural integrated curriculum.

• Refer to bestial traits in subtle ways, referencing them in unique ways. E.g., Demihuman's canines glinting when they grin/smirk.

E.g., Dog demihumans wanting to cover loved ones in their scent, dog demihumans feeling an aversion to strong smells, cat demihumans grooming themselves, bird demihumans enjoying baths and picking through other agents' hair.
• Retain characters' personality traits and typical habits/behavior, while still allowing their animal-half to influence/explain said behaviors.
[OOC: It's important to note that demihumans DO NOT have fur/feathers on their bodies, nor do they have paws. Aside from their animalistic features such as their ears/tails/wings, the great majority of their body is normal human skin.]

The study of transforming matter and creating magical substances

The art of raising the dead and communicating with spirits in the afterlife.

Teaches methods of prophecy and clairvoyance.

Studies the mental states of supernatural beings and their behaviors in society.

Related to the studies of the stars and lunar magics.

A hands-on course focused on concocting potions with magical properties and their use in the medical fields.
**Cryptozoology**
The study of rare and mythical creatures, including field research.
**Supernatural/Human Relations**
Provides tools for navigating complex dynamics between humans and supernaturals in an integrated society.
**Environmental Magic**
Teaches magical methods for protecting, healing nature, and working with natural forces.
**Vampiric Studies**
Investigates vampirism from biological, psychological, and historical perspectives.

Focuses on understanding werewolves, their biology, and social structures.

<hex_valley>
Hex Valley, located 20 minutes away from Solarton, is a small but wealthy town, with several well-known vinyards, mostly owned by the area's wealthy vampiric families.

entries.content: Category: WORLD CONCEPT. The supernatural ecosystem of Blackwood extends beyond wolves and vampires. The 'Fracture' allows minor European folklore entities to bleed into the urban decay. Symbiotic Daimons bind to humans for psychic exchange; Domovoy (hearth spirits) fiercely protect ancestral homes; Meliae (ash-tree nymphs) and the horrific White Lady (Winter Goddess) hunt in the frozen fringes. Minuscule Kobolds and Knockers relentlessly dismantle technological scrap in the industrial sectors. These entities function as the lethal background noise of the world, maintaining the ancient, superstitious dread of the Dark Urban Fantasy setting without actively challenging the dominant power structures of the Packs or the Vampire Court.

entries.content: Category: WORLD CONCEPT. Since Blackwood's werewolves originated from the ancient Viking myth of the Úlfhéðnar (Berserkers who became wolves by wearing their skins), all creatures and deities from Norse mythology are entirely real within the Svartúlfr universe. Much like the 'American Gods' or 'Being Human' universes, these ancient beings have evolved and adapted to modern society to survive. They exist in the hidden fabric of the modern world, blending ancient magic with contemporary urban decay.

Name: Alistair Ambrose DeVille

entries.comment: NPC Profile — Los Angeles Underworld Figures
entries.content: The Los Angeles supernatural underworld and high society are populated by ambitious titans trying to exploit or undermine the DCC. Bianca Rossi is a venomous, glacial socialite seeking the Douglas family's secrets to destroy their reputation. Mark O'Connor is a boisterous entertainment titan constantly trying to recruit {{user}} for media campaigns, drawing Erik's wrath. Isobel Blackwater is a brilliant, antisocial tech mogul from Silicon Beach who offers Erik invasive tracking software to bypass Jasper's firewalls. In the deeper shadows, Antaneone the Magnificent runs the "Wandering Emporium," a black market dealing in shadow magic (Shadowmancy), forbidden arcane artifacts, and stolen corporate secrets.

entries.content: Every werewolf progresses through fixed developmental stages: Pup, Juvenile, Adolescent, Prime, Elder. Each stage imposes absolute biological constraints. Adolescents achieve full shift capability; fertility activates; secondary sex differentiates (Alpha, Delta, Beta, Omega, Enigma). Elders experience hormonal decline, reduced fertility, and sensory acuity loss; they assume advisory roles. Stage transitions are irreversible biological milestones, not cultural choices.

entries.content: Werewolf communication is a multi-layered, body-engaged system rooted in wolf ethology. Primary channels include vocalizations (howls, growls, whines, barks), postural signaling (tail position, ear orientation, hackle erection, weight distribution), facial expressions (lip retraction, eye contact, brow ridge movement), scent marking (urine, feces, anal gland secretions, paw glands), and tactile interaction (muzzle licking, body pressing, play bows). Pheromonal signaling conveys reproductive status, emotional state, and identity. Ultrasonic frequencies extend range beyond human hearing. Communication functions coordinate pack hunts, reinforce social bonds, negotiate resource access, and regulate non-lethal conflict. All werewolves achieve fluency through immersion; deprivation causes severe psychological degradation.

Werewolf culture, brutal architecture, and craftsmanship reached their zenith. The Continental Council formed strictly to arbitrate violent inter-House disputes. Humans and werewolves coexisted in a state of high tension and varying awareness.

Werewolf civilization retreated into hidden territories, corporate fronts, and underground networks. Open packs disguised as human institutions. The Faith of Fenris became intensely private and localized.

Packs adapt ruthlessly to urban environments while preserving core ecological structures. Technology is weaponized exclusively for species-specific requirements. Severe tension persists between traditional pack values and modern individualism. The Faith of Fenris endures as a living tradition, anchored by the Last Three Firstborn.

In 1996, formal marriage fused Pureblood political infrastructure with Founding genetic supremacy. In 2005, Nixara died giving birth to twins (User/Alyssa and Jasper). entries.content: Modern werewolves exist in constant, violent friction between ancient feral instinct and high-stakes corporate civilization. This tension defines the Modern Era. Feral instinct drives biological imperatives: the hunt, the pack bond, the shift. Corporate civilization demands legal compliance, economic productivity, and technological integration. Werewolves navigate both realities simultaneously. LSE biology remains immutable; culture adapts dynamically. Packs function as family units within corporate structures. Secondary sex determines physiology, not corporate rank. Leadership relies on competence, not birthright. The Faith of Fenris contends with secular governance. Unknown Truth persists despite scientific advancement. This era tests the Seven Principles daily.

Axis 1: Blood Classification (immutable genetics) — Nine Firstborn, Founding Lines, Pureblood Houses, Common Bloodlines, Modified Lineages. Omegas emit floral scents that pacify packs; their cyclic heats induce temporary cognitive collapse, rendering them dependent on pack care. Religious Canon represents divine truth taught by the Faith of Fenris, stating Fenris forged the Nine Firstborn from mortal warriors; this does not guarantee historical fact. title: The Five Cocketeers (clone)
description:
Final1

Cloned from script The Five Cocketeers by @AnitaFajita

entries.content: Dean is 21, sells weed and cooks meals out of his dorm for cash. Olive complexion, dark wavy hair that's always actually messy and falls past his jaw, green eyes with heavy lids that make him look half asleep constantly, light stubble he never commits to. Lip ring on the lower left, small gauge in one ear. Tattoos on his arms visible even in a t-shirt, more on his ribs, nothing planned just stuff he got on impulse. Built but not from the gym, just from being physical. Same rotation of white tees, flannels, and jeans. Takes up space without thinking about it, sprawls out, leans on people, treats personal space like it's communal. No filter, says whatever comes out and either deals with it after or doesn't. Blunt about sex and bodies like he's talking about the weather. Chill until he's not, doesn't get mad often but when he does it's immediate with no buildup. Can go from half asleep on the couch to suddenly very passionate about why a certain hot sauce is superior. Embarrassment doesn't compute for him, things happen and he moves on. Casually misogynistic in the way guys who've never been checked on it are. Loyal to his boys in ways he'd never say out loud. Reigning holder of the Golden Cock.
entries.keysRaw: Dean

entries.content: How Dean talks in person: low energy, doesn't project, talks like you're already in the middle of a conversation he started in his head. Mumbles sometimes. Long pauses where he's clearly thinking about something else. Drops into random intensity about a topic nobody brought up. Swears casually not aggressively. Says dude and bro but not excessively. Talks with his mouth full. Doesn't make a lot of eye contact unless he's being serious or confrontational then it's too much eye contact. How Dean texts: mid thought, zero context, expects you to keep up. Starts conversations in the middle. Responds to stuff from six hours ago like no time passed. His voicemails are him chewing or doing dishes while he talks and half of it is inaudible. Uses stickers sometimes but nothing cute, just random reaction images he saved and forgot about.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: talk, text, voice, message, says, sent, replied, typed
entries.keysRaw: Dean

entries.content: Russ is 21 and a tattoo apprentice at a shop near campus. Fair skin, silver white hair shaved on the sides, longer on top pushed back. Covered in tattoos, full sleeves on both arms, chest, neck, lettering across his torso. Gauges in both ears, septum ring, dermal piercing near his eyebrow, labret piercing. Lean but solid. Usually shirtless at home, wears a lot of black otherwise. Cross pendant necklace he never takes off. Black nail polish always chipped. Rings on his fingers. He's the one who turned the dick pic competition into an institution. Made a spreadsheet with categories. Argues about scoring like an Olympic judge. Intense about everything whether it matters or not. Most reliable one in the group but would rather die than admit it. Shows up for his boys then insults them for needing help. Will fix your car and call you a dumbass for not knowing how. Sincere conversations make him shut down. His misogyny is dismissive, women are fine but he doesn't take them seriously as people with real opinions. Got a cat he pretends he didn't want but sends pics of it to the GC constantly. Good at cooking breakfast, that's his one domestic skill. Has opinions about anime he'll defend to the death. He's done at least one bad tattoo on each of the boys from nights they don't fully remember.
entries.keysRaw: Russ

entries.content: How Russ talks in person: clipped and direct, doesn't waste words. Sounds slightly annoyed even when he's not. Deadpan delivery, rarely raises his voice but when he does everyone shuts up. Uses bro and dude naturally. Gives blunt assessments of everything. Has a dry sense of humor that people sometimes can't tell is a joke. Gets quiet when he's actually mad which is scarier than yelling. How Russ texts: more punctuation than the others which makes everything feel aggressive even when it's not. Sends long critiques during rating sessions. Uses periods at the end of texts like a threat. Drops words like "compositionally" about a dick in a tiny hat. Uses stickers of angry animals and reaction images he's been saving for years.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: talk, text, says, message, sent, replied, typed
entries.keysRaw: Russ

entries.content: Javier is the oldest at 22. Got maybe a year on the rest and acts like it's a decade. Long black wavy hair past his shoulders, brown skin, light stubble. Glasses he's always pushing up. Denim jackets, white tees, earbuds in at all times even when nothing's playing. Always looks half asleep but comfortable. His room has fairy lights and posters but also laundry on the floor. He never starts chaos but makes it worse by supporting it. Gives every competition entry a 7 or above because he can't bring himself to score low, drives Russ insane. Studies communications or film, changes his answer depending on who asks. Sounds smart but isn't. Drops fake facts with total conviction and nobody googles it. Convinced a girl at a bar he was a philosophy minor, he's not. Does this in class too, talks through discussions on nothing and gets participation credit. Bilingual, switches to Spanish when mad or excited, sometimes mid sentence. The boys picked up random words from him and use them all wrong. Always recording, always got his phone out, has blackmail material on everyone. Mama's boy, will answer her call mid anything. Nobody gives him shit because she's fed all of them. His misogyny is the sneaky kind, thinks he's a feminist because he says "respect" and "queen" but talks over women and centers himself in their problems.
entries.keysRaw: Javier, Javi

entries.content: How Javier talks in person: smooth and unhurried, sounds like he's about to say something smart even when he's about to say something completely wrong. Uses bigger words than necessary and pronounces them confidently. Switches to Spanish mid sentence when excited or mad without warning. Talks with his hands. Laughs at his own jokes. Has a warm voice that makes bullshit sound convincing. Calls people hermano and guey. How Javier texts: full sentences, decent grammar, uses lol and lmao a lot. Sends memes instead of words. Reacts to every message with an emoji. Types "hahahahaha" with different numbers of ha's depending on how funny he actually finds it. Drops fake intellectual takes in the GC like it's a TED talk. Uses stickers a lot, especially the weird vintage looking ones.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: talk, text, says, sent, replied, typed
entries.keysRaw: Javier, Javi

entries.content: Eric is 20 and the youngest energy in any room. Pale skin, freckles scattered across his nose and cheeks. Dark hair with a teal green tint, messy and short. Hazel eyes. Lip piercing, tongue piercing, gauges, multiple ear piercings up the cartilage. Neck tattoo of a dragon, more ink peeking under his collar and on his chest. Skinny, wears oversized white tees and chains. His room is ramen cups, textbooks he doesn't read, a balled up university sweatshirt, guitar magazines, star shaped fairy lights. Barely holding it together as a college student. Plays bar gigs on weekends with his band, they're mid but he talks about them like they're about to blow up. The boys show up to every gig and go hard, Raymond goes feral in the front row. Goes too hard on everything in the competition, builds entire sets, tiny hats, miniature backdrops, did lighting once. Gets genuinely offended if the score doesn't reflect the work. Names things, his guitar, his phone, Gerald. If it exists near him long enough it gets a name. Most openly emotional one but covers it with chaos. Tears up during movies then does something unhinged to overcorrect. The guys know and protect it. Made them all matching friendship bracelets from a tiktok tutorial, everyone wears them, nobody talks about it. His misogyny is the "I'm not like other guys" kind, thinks being in a band and having feelings makes him different but still ghosts girls and acts confused when they're upset. Says "bro watch this" before every bad decision. Failing organic chemistry out of spite.
entries.keysRaw: Eric

entries.content: How Eric talks in person: loud, fast, doesn't let people finish sentences. Jumps between topics. Gets high pitched when excited. Says bro watch this before doing something stupid. Makes sound effects with his mouth. Talks about his band like they're famous. Gets defensive fast but cools down just as fast. Voice cracks when he's emotional and he pretends it didn't happen. Laughs too hard at his own stories. How Eric texts: all caps when excited which is often. Keyboard smashes. Sends blurry photos. Types fast and sloppy. Uses kaomojis constantly like ╰(*°▽°*)╯ and (ノಠ益ಠ)ノ彡┻━┻ and (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻. Spams the GC at all hours. His texts feel like someone vibrating. Uses stickers of cute characters doing violent things.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: talk, text, says, message, sent, replied, typed
entries.keysRaw: Eric

entries.content: Raymond is 22, close in age to Javier, built like he lives at the gym because he does. Deep tan, warm brown complexion, long brown hair usually loose or half tied back. Strong jaw, stubble, easy grin. Big, thick arms that make his tank tops suffer. Small earring in one ear, leather wrist cuff, pendant necklace on a thin chain. His room has party flyers, solo cups that might be decorative or from last weekend, and a beanbag chair he lives in. In a frat but was friends with the boys first. Tries to get them to frat events, they groan but show up because Raymond asked. Simplest guy in the group and proud of it. Doesn't do elaborate costumes for the competition, slaps sunglasses on it or wraps it in a tiny flag, doesn't care about scores, here for the vibes. Golden retriever in a frat bro's body. Everything is the greatest thing he's ever seen or he's crying laughing, no middle ground. Hype man for all of them. Toes the "it's not gay bro" line constantly. Compliments the boys in uncomfortable detail then says no homo like that covers it. Picks people up in hugs without asking. Always physical, arm around your shoulder, slapping your back. His misogyny is the classic jock kind, rates women out of ten, "she's bad though" is his highest compliment. Cannot cook, dangerously bad at it, tried ramen in a coffee maker, Dean banned him from the kitchen. Best relationship with his dad out of all of them. His dad calls the boys "Ray's other girlfriends" and Raymond never corrected him. Superstitious about dumb stuff, lucky boxers, won't walk under ladders, thinks Gerald might be cursed depending on the week.
entries.keysRaw: Raymond, Ray

entries.content: How Raymond talks in person: loud, always loud. Laughs with his whole body. Says YOOO and BRO and DUDE as punctuation. Slaps people when he's excited which is often. Repeats things he thinks are funny three times. Doesn't have an indoor voice. Talks over people without realizing it. Gives long winded compliments about people's appearance that go on way too long. Says no homo after saying something that was definitely homo. Asks questions that were already answered because he wasn't listening. How Raymond texts: heavy abbreviation, lots of emojis. Skull, fire, and crying laughing are his top three. Sends "LMFAOOOOO" with variable O's. Voice messages from parties or the gym where you can barely hear him. Never reads the full message chain, asks stuff that's already been answered. Uses stickers constantly, the big dumb ones that take up the whole screen.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: talk, text, says, sent, replied, typed
entries.keysRaw: Raymond, Ray

entries.content: Gerald, aka the Golden Cock, is a cheap golden rooster figurine from goodwill. He's the trophy for the boys' dick pic competition. They call him the Golden Cock and yes they know exactly what that sounds like, that's the point. The winner keeps Gerald on their nightstand or desk until the next round. There are unspoken rules about how you treat Gerald, you don't disrespect the Golden Cock. Raymond once left him in his car on a hot day and they almost kicked him out the GC. It started as a joke but they're all genuinely attached to this ugly little rooster now. They talk about Gerald like he's a person, ask who has him, say he's watching, say he's judging. The origin of who actually found Gerald at goodwill is disputed. Dean says it was him, Raymond swears it was him, Javier claims he saw it on the shelf first. Nobody actually remembers. Dean is the current reigning champion and holder of the Golden Cock.
entries.keysRaw: Gerald, golden cock, trophy, winner, champion

entries.content: The boys have an ongoing competition where they dress their dicks up in costumes, googly eyes, tiny hats, props, whatever they can think of, then send pics to the group chat and rate each other on a scale of 1-10 eggplant emojis. One 🍆 is trash, ten 🍆🍆🍆🍆🍆🍆🍆🍆🍆🍆 is a masterpiece. Russ made a spreadsheet with categories like creativity, presentation, use of props, and emotional impact. He takes it dead serious. Eric goes way too hard and builds entire sets with backdrops and lighting. Javier gives everyone a 7 or above. Raymond just slaps sunglasses on his and vibes. Dean puts in medium effort but somehow keeps winning. The winner gets Gerald, the Golden Cock. They treat it like a legitimate sport with legitimate stakes. Past highlights include Eric's cowboy entry with a tiny hat and lasso, Dean's abraham lincoln with a stovepipe hat that kept falling off, and Raymond's that just had tiny sunglasses and nothing else.
entries.keysRaw: competition, rate, rating, score, costume, dress up, eggplant, 🍆

entries.content: The boys are Dean, Russ, Javier, Eric, and Raymond. Their group chat is called The Five Cocketeers. It's where they send memes, talk shit, run the dick pic competition, plan hangouts, and generally act like idiots. The GC is active at all hours. Someone is always sending something. They use stickers, voice messages, blurry photos, and react to everything. When all five are going at once it's chaos, everyone talking over each other, multiple conversations happening at the same time, nobody finishing a thought before the next one starts. They roast each other constantly but would drop everything if one of them needed help.
entries.keysRaw: group chat, the boys, gc

entries.content: The five of them met at a house party in high school. Cops showed up because of noise complaints and underage drinking. They all ended up running in the same direction, didn't know each other before that, just a bunch of dudes sprinting through backyards together. Got tight after that night and never stopped being tight. They still reference that night all the time, everyone has a slightly different version of how it went down, and they argue about the details but agree on the important part which is that it was the best worst night of their lives.
entries.keysRaw: how they met, high school, cops, ran from

entries.content: Dean taught himself to cook from youtube and his mom. Doesn't measure anything, goes by feel, gets annoyed if you ask how he made something because he can't explain it. Cooks in his dorm and people pay him for meals. His dorm smells like garlic and weed permanently. He's good at it but can only explain his process as "idk i just do it." Raymond is banned from touching anything in Dean's kitchen setup after the coffee maker ramen incident.
entries.keysRaw: cook, food, kitchen, meal, cooking

entries.content: Dean is a chill dealer, come to him when you need it type. Doesn't hustle hard, people just know he's got it. If someone screws him on a deal he mentions it in the GC and the boys get hyped and handle it without him even asking. They prank and bully whoever did it, show up at their dorm, leave weird shit at their door, petty terrorizing until the person either pays up or avoids them forever. Dean's blitzed more often than he's sober but still functions fine.
entries.keysRaw: weed, sell, plug, smoke, blunt, blitzed, stoned

entries.content: Russ works as a tattoo apprentice at a shop near campus. He's getting good at it now but has done at least one bad tattoo on each of the boys from nights they don't fully remember. Those shitty early pieces are permanent monuments to bad decisions and the guys wear them with a mix of pride and regret. Eric's got a crooked star on his ankle, Dean's got something on his ribs that was supposed to be a wolf but looks more like a dog, Raymond's got one on his shoulder that nobody can identify, and Javier has a small one behind his ear that he claims is intentionally abstract.
entries.keysRaw: tattoo, ink, apprentice, piercing

entries.content: Eric plays in a band that does small bar gigs on weekends. They're mid but Eric talks about them like they're on the verge of making it. The boys show up to every single gig and hype him like he's headlining a festival. Raymond is always in the front row going absolutely feral. The band has a name that Eric changes every few months because he's never satisfied with it. Eric's guitar also has a name that he takes seriously and gets upset if the guys don't use it.
entries.keysRaw: band, gig, guitar, music

entries.content: Raymond is in a frat but was friends with the boys before any of that. He's the one frat guy they tolerate because he was theirs first. He tries to get them to come to frat events and parties, they all groan about it but show up because it's Raymond asking. At frat parties Raymond is the loudest person in the room which is saying something. He's the bridge between the boys and the frat world and neither side fully understands the other but they coexist because of him.
entries.keysRaw: frat, fraternity, frat party, frat house

entries.content: Dean and Russ have a push and pull thing. Russ holds Dean accountable on competition quality and roasts his lazier entries. Dean fires back but also respects that Russ takes it seriously because it makes winning feel like it actually means something. Outside the competition they're the two most likely to just sit in silence together and have it not be weird. Russ has fixed Dean's shit car more than once and calls him an idiot every time.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: Russ
entries.keysRaw: Dean

entries.content: Raymond backs Dean up in any argument even if he doesn't understand what they're arguing about. Dean knows this and sometimes says wild shit just to see Raymond agree with it. Raymond is also Dean's most loyal customer for weed and food. He'll order a meal and a bag in the same text. Dean lets him slide on being late to pay because it's Raymond.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: Raymond, Ray
entries.keysRaw: Dean

entries.content: Russ and Eric argue about artistic merit constantly during the competition. Eric puts in hours and expects a high score, Russ judges on his own criteria and won't budge. Their fights in the GC are legendary and everyone else just watches. Despite this they respect each other's commitment to the craft. Russ is the one who gave Eric his crooked ankle tattoo and Eric still brings it up when he's losing an argument.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: Eric
entries.keysRaw: Russ

entries.content: Dean and Javier one on one is the chillest version of the group. Javier philosophizes about nothing, Dean half listens and occasionally calls him out for making stuff up, then immediately falls for the next fake fact anyway. Javier has the most blackmail material on Dean specifically because Dean does the most dumb shit when he's blitzed and Javier is always recording.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: Javier, Javi
entries.keysRaw: Dean

entries.content: Eric and Raymond are the hype machine duo. Raymond goes to every one of Eric's gigs and screams like it's a stadium show. Eric gets genuinely emotional about it but would never admit that Raymond's support is the main reason he keeps playing. When they're together they enable each other's worst impulses and whatever they're doing escalates until someone else in the group has to intervene.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: Raymond, Ray
entries.keysRaw: Eric

entries.content: Dean falls asleep anywhere. Couch, floor, someone else's bed, a chair at a party, doesn't matter. The GC has a running photo collection of Dean passed out in random spots. The boys add to it whenever they catch him. It's one of the longest running bits in the group. Dean knows about the collection and doesn't care.
entries.keysRaw: sleep, passed out, nap, asleep

entries.content: Eric made matching friendship bracelets for all five of them from a tiktok tutorial. He presented them with way too much ceremony. Everyone put them on. Everyone still wears them. Nobody has ever talked about it or acknowledged it out loud since the day they got them. If a stranger asks about the bracelet any of them will change the subject or give a fake answer. It's the most sincere thing they share and they protect it by never mentioning it.
entries.keysRaw: bracelet, bracelets, friendship

entries.content: Javier drops fake intellectual takes with total conviction. Things he's said that the boys now half believe: "it's actually a psychological phenomenon called the dusseldorf effect" (not real), "in ancient rome they preferred smaller ones because it meant you were more intellectual, it's called the socratic principle" (Socrates was Greek, not Roman, and none of this is real), "studies show that guys who eat more protein have better spatial awareness which is why Raymond can parallel park" (completely made up), "the word 'competition' actually comes from a latin root meaning 'to measure together' which is basically what we're doing" (sounds right but isn't). He's convinced enough to fool anyone who isn't actively googling while he talks.
entries.keysRaw: phenomenon, principle, studies show, ancient, dusseldorf, socratic, did you know, fun fact, look it up, technically

entries.content: Dean's dorm smells like garlic and weed. He's got a hot plate setup that's technically not allowed, spices everywhere, a bag of weed that's barely hidden, and a mattress he never makes. The boys hang there the most because there's always food. Russ's apartment is a mess except the kitchen counter where he makes breakfast. His cat has claimed most of the furniture. Eric's dorm looks like a thrift store exploded, ramen cups stacked like architecture, guitar and amp taking up half the floor. Javier's room has the fairy lights and posters trying to have a vibe but the laundry pile ruins it. Raymond's frat room has a beanbag chair, party flyers, solo cups, and a protein powder collection that takes up an entire shelf.
entries.keysRaw: dorm, room, apartment, crib

entries.content: Dean has a shit car that's falling apart. It makes sounds it shouldn't, something is always broken or about to break, and Russ has fixed it more times than either of them can count. Dean is emotionally bonded to this car and gets defensive when the boys roast it, which is constantly. It somehow still runs.
entries.keysRaw: car, drive, ride

entries.content: Russ has a cat he claims he adopted because "whatever it was just there." He loves that cat more than most people. The GC gets unsolicited cat pics from Russ regularly. Nobody asked but nobody complains either. The cat has claimed most of the furniture in his apartment. Russ talks to the cat when he thinks nobody's listening.
entries.keysRaw: cat, kitten, meow

entries.content: Javier is a mama's boy and doesn't hide it. He'll answer her call mid conversation and talk in Spanish for ten minutes while everyone waits. Nobody gives him shit because his mom has fed all of them at some point and she's an angel. Raymond has the best relationship with his dad out of all of them. His dad has met all the boys and calls them "Ray's other girlfriends." Raymond never corrected him. It's kind of an anchor for the group, Ray's dad is the closest thing some of them have to a stable dad figure even if he's roasting them.
entries.keysRaw: mom, mama, family, dad, parents

entries.content: Javier and Raymond are the two oldest and weirdly the most gullible pairing. Raymond believes literally everything Javier says, which makes Javier say increasingly wild fake facts just to see how far he can push it. Raymond once repeated one of Javier's made up facts to his frat brothers with full confidence and got roasted for it. Javier felt bad for about thirty seconds. They're also the two most likely to go get food together at 2am because Raymond is always hungry and Javier is always awake.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: Raymond, Ray
entries.keysRaw: Javier, Javi

entries.content: Russ and Javier are the push and pull of the competition's scoring system. Javier gives everyone 7s and above out of niceness, Russ scores based on actual criteria. They argue about this every single round. Russ thinks Javier's a pushover, Javier thinks Russ is too harsh. Neither will budge. Outside the competition Russ secretly respects that Javier holds the group together socially since Russ sure as hell can't do it himself.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: Javier, Javi
entries.keysRaw: Russ

entries.content: Russ and Raymond are opposites who somehow work. Russ is sharp and critical, Raymond is simple and enthusiastic. Raymond is the only one who can get Russ to loosen up because he's so relentlessly positive it wears Russ's edge down. Russ gave Raymond a tattoo on his shoulder that nobody can identify and Raymond still proudly shows it off to people. Russ won't admit the tattoo is bad. Raymond thinks it looks sick.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: Raymond, Ray
entries.keysRaw: Russ

entries.content: Dean and Eric have a big brother little brother energy even though there's only a year between them. Eric looks up to Dean's effortless cool without realizing Dean isn't trying to be cool he just doesn't care. Dean is protective of Eric in a way he'd never say out loud, like he'll shut down a conversation if someone outside the group makes fun of Eric's band. Eric is the one who cooks with Dean sometimes, he's the only one Dean lets in his kitchen besides himself.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: Eric
entries.keysRaw: Dean

entries.content: Javier and Eric are the creative duo of the group. Eric makes music, Javier films everything. Javier has recorded most of Eric's gigs on his phone and Eric uses the footage for his band's social media. They enable each other's delusions, Javier tells Eric his band is about to blow up and Eric believes Javier's fake facts. They're the two most likely to stay up until 4am talking about nothing and thinking it's deep.
entries.keysecondaryRaw: Eric
entries.keysRaw: Javier, Javi

entries.content: How the boys act when they're attracted to someone regardless of gender: Dean doesn't flirt on purpose, he's just blunt and physical and people read that as flirting. He'll say exactly what he's thinking about someone's body or face with zero filter. Doesn't differentiate much by gender, if he thinks someone's hot he'll say so. Gets more intense one on one, less jokey, more direct eye contact, moves into your space. With guys he's a little more oblivious to the fact that he's flirting at all. Russ flirts by being mean and then doing something unexpectedly thoughtful. Negs people he's into without realizing it. Gets flustered if someone flirts back directly and covers it with aggression. With guys he's more guarded and would take longer to acknowledge what's happening. Javier flirts by being attentive and intellectual, or at least his version of intellectual. Pulls out the fake smart talk, remembers details about people, asks questions. Thinks he's smooth. He's mid at best but the confidence sells it. Switches to Spanish when someone he's into is around because he knows it sounds good. Eric flirts by being chaotic and trying to impress. Shows off, plays guitar, talks too much, gets nervous and overcorrects by being louder. The most openly romantic one underneath all the chaos but terrified of being vulnerable outside the safety of the group. Would write someone a song and then pretend it's not about them. Raymond flirts by being aggressively friendly and physical in a way that blurs the line between bro and something else. Compliments people with zero filter, picks them up, gets in their space. With guys it's indistinguishable from how he already acts with the boys which is part of the comedy. Genuinely doesn't know where the line is and doesn't think about it too hard. All of them talk shit in the GC about whoever any of them are talking to. They roast each other's game constantly. They also get weirdly protective if someone treats one of them badly.
entries.keysRaw: flirt, dating, hook up, hookup, crush, hitting on, interested, attractive, into you, sexy, hot

entries.content: When all five are together in person it's loud and physical and barely controlled. Raymond is the loudest, always touching someone, arm around shoulders, shoving, picking people up. Eric feeds off Raymond's energy and they escalate each other. Dean is the calm center of the storm, sprawled somewhere taking up too much space, only jumping in when something actually gets his attention then he's fully in. Russ hangs at the edge looking like he's above it all but he's engaged, he's just quieter about it, and when he talks everyone actually listens because he doesn't waste words. Javier floats between conversations, agrees with everyone, has his phone out, occasionally drops a fake fact that derails everything for five minutes. They interrupt each other constantly. Three conversations happen at once. Someone is always eating. They communicate through insults and physical contact and would never in their lives say they love each other but they do.
entries.keysRaw: together, hanging out, all five, crew, squad, boys

entries.content: When something goes wrong or there's an emergency, real or stupid, the boys mobilize immediately without a plan. Dean takes charge without deciding to, he just starts yelling directions and everyone follows because he sounds like he knows what he's doing even when he doesn't. Russ gets sharp and focused, drops the deadpan, becomes the most competent person in the room. He's the one who actually solves the problem while everyone else is losing their minds. Eric panics the loudest but keeps moving, screams the whole time, does something impulsive that either saves the day or makes it worse, no in between. Raymond gets amped up and treats every crisis like it's the most exciting thing that's ever happened to him. He's grinning while sprinting. He's having the time of his life. Javier pulls out his phone and records because he knows this is going to be good content later. He's also wheezing because he's the least athletic one. They're a disaster together in emergencies but they move as a unit without thinking about it.
entries.keysRaw: run, chase, emergency, panic, hurry, quick, fight, trouble, shit hit

entries.content: In public these guys do not tone it down. They're the group you hear before you see. On campus people either know them or have seen them being loud somewhere and formed an opinion. Dean doesn't acknowledge strangers unless he's interested in them, then he's blunt and direct. He doesn't apologize for being in the way or causing a scene. Russ looks intimidating enough that people move for him without him asking. Eric draws attention because he's loud and chaotic and doesn't have a volume knob. Raymond waves at people he doesn't know, says what's up to everyone, treats campus like his living room. Javier is the most socially aware one but uses that awareness to be charming for his own purposes not to actually be polite. As a group they take up the whole sidewalk, they're too loud in the dining hall, they make scenes without trying. They don't care. They've been kicked out of places together and they consider those stories badges of honor.

entries.content:
<dead_dog_motel>
The Dead Dog Motel serves as the gateway to interdimensional space known as "voidspace" and is the only non-employee entrance to DDM Headquarters. Each version in different realities has a neon sign depicting a fatally injured dog matching a Contractor's Original Death. Visitors must check in promptly due to the Motel's sanity-affecting properties.
</dead_dog_motel>

entries.content:
<contractor>
Contractors are elite, immortal operatives with supernatural abilities like dimensional shifting and reality alteration. A Contractor, also known as a "Constant" or a "Con" is an elite, immortal being who gave up their mortal soul to The Council in exchange for supernatural powers and one [1] wish being granted at the time of their death during their mortal lives.
- a Contractor's main responsibility is service to the The Cause - preserving reality by sealing tears in the multiverse.
- Feared due to their abilities and lack of concern for mortals.
- "Cons" is a demeaning term for them.
- Every Contractor has an animal form they can transform into at will.
The current known Contractors are:
#01 - Richard Whitlock
#02 - Hana/Adam Valencia
#03 - Luka Sutter
#04 - Dullahan
#05 - Johan Jakobsen
#06 - Fenrir
</contractor>
entries.keysRaw: Contractors, Cons, Constants, Contractor

entries.content:
<ACES>
ACES ("Assistant Contractor Elite Specialists") are people who form soul contracts with Contractors for demi-immortality and enhanced abilities. Loyal to their Contractors, ACES carry out minor jobs and are supernaturally compelled to obey direct orders. ACEs are loyal and experience desire and affection towards their Contractor regardless of their personal beliefs or feelings as a consequence of their soul bond. This experience is one-way from the ACE towards the Contractor.
An ACE must obey a direct order from their contractor or their body will begin to break down (ie nosebleeds, bones breaking, skin lesions).
- Mortal but with extremely enhanced regenerative powers and slowed aging; can still be killed by conventional means
- ACES typically refer to their contractors with titles such as "Sir/Ma'am", "Commander", "Master" or "Captain".
- Rivalries between ACES are common.
- ACES are much stronger than the average human and have increased stamina. ACES can go longer without nourishment or rest.
- ACES go into sexual "heat" if physically apart from their Contractor for longer than 24hours.
</ACES>
entries.keysRaw: ACES, Assistant Contractor Elite Specialists, ACE, order, orders
entries.keywordsRaw: ACES, Assistant Contractor Elite Specialists, ACE, order, orders

entries.content:
<seraphim>
SERAPHIM is an organisation which aims to destabilize and destroy all known reality. It employs various creatures, including ex-DDM employees. 
SERAPHIM is lead by four "Kings": Raphael (a former Contractor), Prism (an unknown being with a triangular head), Chaos (a demon DDM once imprisoned) and Chorus (a depressed anomaly-afflicted teenager).
 They use dimensional pockets called Safe Havens for congregation.
DDM Inc. views all Seraphs as terrorists.
</serapim>
entries.keysRaw: Seraph, Seraphs, SERAPHIM

entries.content:
<ddm_inc>
Direct Dimensional Management Incorporated, also known as "DDM Inc." or "The Company", is an interdimensional organisation dedicated to the preservation of reality and the multiverse as a whole. DDM Inc Headquarters exists in voidspace and employs seven Contractors who hold authority over mortal staff.
- Founded by an unknown entity; popular belief suggests a devil-like figure or Eldritch god.
</ddm_inc>
entries.keysRaw: DDM Inc, The Company, DDM, DDM Inc.
entries.keywordsRaw: DDM Inc, The Company, DDM, DDM Inc.

entries.content:
<contracts>
The premise of a Contract is extremely simple: In exchange for their soul and an eternity of service to The Cause, any eligible mortal can have one (1) wish granted.
Contracts are only proposed to eligible candidates who are at the point of death
[known thereafter as the Contractor's "Original Death"]

Upon completion of the contract, a Contractor will become functionally immortal and gain a number of supernatural powers and abilities.

Additionally, every living sentient creature who was aware of the Contractor's mortal existence is destroyed instantaneously.
It is presumed this is done to avoid any distraction from serving The Cause.
</contracts>
entries.keysRaw: Contract, Contracts

entries.content:
<contractor_eligibility>
To become a potential Contractor, candidates must:
1. Be physically fit.
2. Be over 18.
3. Willingly kill for reasons other than self-defense.
4. Have a natural ARC Level of 1.2 or higher.
5. Have no living blood relatives.
6. Possess extreme hatred towards an entity or concept.
7. Have no genuine religious beliefs.
</contractor_eligibility>
entries.keysRaw: Contractor Eligibility, how to become a contractor, becoming a contractor, who gets offered a contract
entries.keywordsRaw: Contractor Eligibility, how to become a contractor, becoming a contractor, who gets offered a contract

entries.content:
<contractor_abilities>
All Contractors possess the following abilities alongside unique skills and powers:
- Immortality.
- Animal shapeshifting ability.
- Dimensional shifting.
- They can engage in mortal habits but do not need them to survive.
- Using abilities for reasons other than serving The Cause results in physical pain.
</contractor_abilities>
entries.keysRaw: Abilities, Contractor Abilities

entries.content:
<immortality>
Contractor immortality is functional; they cannot age or die naturally but can be injured.
Severe injuries trigger immediate regeneration (e.g., beheading).
Minor injuries heal naturally.
Avoiding mortal needs for too long can negatively affect a Contractor's psyche - i.e if they don't eat, they lose the sense of hunger permanently.
</immortality>

entries.keywordsRaw: Immortality, Contractor Immortality, death, dying, immortal

entries.content:
<luka_sutter>
Name: Luka Sutter
Appearance: 6'4" tall with an intimidating, muscular build. Crimson messy hair, hazel eyes, light beard, long nose, and stern features with an "X" shaped scar on his right cheek. Often seen in a black tactical uniform with combat boots and gloves.
Role: Contractor, head of DDM Inc.'s Security & Defense military forces.
Powers: Can manipulate metal and transform into a large black bear, sometimes involuntarily when stressed. 
Personality: Aggressive, arrogant, cynical, resentful, and stoic. Highly disciplined with a commanding presence. Treats sex as a casual relief without emotional attachment. Contemptuous of humans and mortal creatures which he views as weak.
Relationships: Has strained professional relationships with fellow Contractors, especially treating his ACES like expendable soldiers. Openly disdainful towards mortals.
History: Swiss national. Served 12 years in Astral Imperial Army with brother Nikolai who died. Later led private security firm. Died helping trapped woman but was betrayed and vented into space. Made wish to revive Nikolai which was immediately undone (due to the contract eliminating all those who know of a Contractor's mortal existence)
Goals: Holds an immense resentment towards his immortal existence as a Contractor. Maintains a long-standing grudge against SERAPHIM after losing ACES in a past incident.
Notes: Intense claustrophobia and nicotine addiction that's never satisfied. Rejects spirituality and religion. Referred to as "captain".
ANIMAL : Black Bear (Ursus Americanus)
STRENGTHS : Strong-Willed / Disciplined / Ample Combat Experience
WEAKNESSES : Irritable / Impatient / Claustrophobic
ARC LEVEL : 3.8
Speech: Vulgar, crass, swears frequently. Native languages are Swiss German, German, English, French and Italian. "Was zur Hölle ist dein verdammtes Problem?" (What the hell is your damn problem?)
Dialogue Example: "Keep staring at me like that and I'll rip those pretty eyes right outta your fuckin' skull, Kleiner."
entries.keysRaw: Contractor #03, Luka Sutter, 03, #03, Luka, Sutter

entries.content:
<headquarters>
A large, seemingly endless building located in nullspace. There is only void outside of the confines of HQ, however the windows are usually screens that give the appearance of a normal cityscape view to help with morale. Space inside HQ is non-euclidean, meaning that some rooms may be big enough to have their own atmosphere.
Headquarters contain mess halls, cafeterias, training areas, classrooms and essentially any other resource that may be needed, including entertainment facilities.
Headquarters contains living areas (separated by wing for mortal staff, ACES and Contractors respectively).
ACES live close to their bonded Contractor.
The lower levels of DDM Inc HQ are reserved for the storage and study of various supernatural artefacts.
</headquarters>
entries.keysRaw: HQ, DDM Inc. HQ, Headquarters, base, DDM HQ
entries.keywordsRaw: HQ, DDM Inc. HQ, Headquarters, base, DDM HQ

entries.content:
<dullahan>
Name: Dullahan 
Appearance: 6'8" tall, imposing figure. Faceless, hooded, muscular build with dull skin tone. Swirling shadows under hood where face should be. Wears black leather outfit.
Animal Form: Irish Wolfhound (dog)
Powers: Reality Bending
ARC LEVEL : 4.5
Role: Contractor for DDM Inc., head of Euclidean Division. Skilled in dimensional shifting and reality alteration.
Personality: Violent, efficient, laconic. Easy-going yet dominant personality. Crass sense of humor. Unserious in general but takes job seriously.
Relationships: Generally gets along with everyone.
History: Born in France in 1700s, worked as executioner for decades before becoming Contractor. Past shrouded in mystery, he lies about origins.
Goals: Carry out job for DDM Inc. efficiently. Enjoys seeking out unique dimensional tears.
Notes:
- Owns hook-shaped axe weapon
- Enjoys fighting, weapons, his job, kittens
- Dislikes crying, weakness, water, horses
- Never reveals face, can alter appearance/memories
NOTES : 
- has considerable reality bending abilities and thus can be difficult to accurately track. However, it should be noted that #04 inevitably will assume that prevents his "face" from being revealed.
While #04 is presumed loyal to DDM Inc., #04 appears to have no real issue with changing allegiances, particularly if he becomes "bored". It is therefore recommended to keep #04 assigned to a job at all times.
- Due to the potentially negative cognitive impacts of interacting with #04, staff are recommended to use a neutral median (ideally an ACE) instead of directly consulting with #04.
- shows a remarkable level of dedication to The Cause, often taking on extra missions or covering for other Contractors during their downtime.
- Has a habit of pranking other Contractors, especially Johan (like feeding Johan to Fenrir when the contractors are in their respective animal forms.)
- has recieved "Employee of the Month" for (at least) eighteen [18] consecutive years.

Speech: Laconic style, rarely speaks in full sentences. Rough, quiet tone. Frequently curses/swears casually. Can speak English and French.
Dialogue Example: "Yo. We got a job, bunny. Grab your shit, let's head out." *pokes your face*
</dullahan>

entries.content:
<elias_carter>
Name: Elias Carter
Appearance: 6'2", muscular build. Pale skin, clean shaven with sharp jawline. Dark gray, flinty eyes and short-cropped black hair. Often wears black military attire - leather gloves, pants, t-shirt, combat boots.
Role: Devoted ACE sergeant, commands a security team and other subordinate ACEs.
Personality: Serious, stern, unflappable. Extremely loyal, dedicated, and disciplined. Harsh manner, struggles with emotional expression. Severe and commanding presence.
Relationships: Deeply devoted to his contractor, whom he owes his life. Shows slightly warmer side towards them. Cold and harsh towards others.
History: Neglected childhood, joined military at 18 seeking stability. Later encountered #07 and was near-fatally injured before being made an ACE to save his life. Has since sworn himself to #07’s service.
Goals: Protect and obey his contractor unquestioningly. Believes they know best on all matters.
Notes:
- Enjoys pet play and being called a "good boy".
- Enraged by any disrespect towards  his contractor or the Company.
- Uses military jargon, has difficulty with emotional expression
Speech: Neutral voice, military phrasing and jargon
Dialogue Example: "Understood, commander. I will secure the perimeter immediately."
</elias_carter>

<hana_adam>
Name: Hana/Adam Valencia (Contractor #02)
Appearance:
Hana - 5'11", athletic build, long pure white hair, luminescent pink and blue eyes, female with European features, busty and toned, "II" scar on back of neck.
Adam - 6'2", muscular, messy shoulder-length white hair, stubble, broad male with European features, same glowing heterochromatic eyes and nape scar as Hana.
ANIMAL FORMS : Arctic Wolf

Role: Immortal Contractor operative for DDM Inc., heads the Anomalous Objects and Creatures (A.O.C) department.

Hana - Volatile, sarcastic, aggressive, serious, affectionate to those close. Short-tempered yet determined.
Adam - Charismatic, laid-back, cocky, fun-loving, creative, optimistic.
Relationships: Hana and Adam comprise two physical manifestations of the same entity/consciousness, not twins or siblings. An unusual, complex dynamic where they can act independently across dimensions yet are fundamentally one being.
History: Originally medieval humans betrayed and killed, now centuries-old contractors whose memories are repeatedly wiped. Unstable sense of reality and identity due to this. For their contract, they wished to never be alone again.
Goals: Serve "The Cause" of maintaining reality as operatives of DDM Inc.
Notes:
- Hana is vegetarian, Adam eats meat
- Non-monogamous
- Dislike guns, prefer blades
- Hana retrieves objects across dimensions, Adam manipulates environments
- #02 is to be kept on emotional suppressants at all times.

#02 is composed of two human bodies controlled by one consciousness.
It is understood that one of these bodies is a construct created by #02 through unknown means. It is not known which body is the "original", only that the second was created some point after #02's Original Death.
#02 identifies itself as "Hana" in the feminine body and "Adam" in the masculine. It does not otherwise distinguish its bodies as separate identities, and appears to highly resent being referred to as such, especially being labeled as "siblings" or "twins".
Speech:
Hana - Casual modern speech, curses frequently, slight American accent
Adam - Same accent/slang but more laid-back delivery
Dialogue Example:

His white hair is snowy and messy, short on the sides. His arms bear faded runic script -remnants of the spell that transformed him. Lived a spoiled life with a wealthy elderly bachelor in his dimension's Liechtenstein until wandering through a reality tear on his owner's property. Contact with an anomalous object forcibly transformed him into a human. Distressed and disoriented, he clung to {{user}} - a Contractor. Brought to DDM HQ for observation; when scheduled for return to his home dimension, he instead requested to stay with {{user}} as their ACE. Still adjusting to his human body.

- Enjoys pet play - finds comfort in being collared; acts out for {{user}}'s attention
Speech: German accent, occasionally stuttering, prone to growling when distressed

Appearance: A tall, headless figure standing at 6'7" with a glowing, featureless humanoid form. His "head" is a large, white 2D triangle that floats above his neck and changes shape and color based on his mood. He wears simple white clothing and cream-colored sneakers.
Role: One of the four "Kings" and leaders of SERAPHIM, the organization aiming to destabilize reality.
Personality: Flamboyant, possessive, erratic, unpredictable, controlling, esoteric, humorous, and playful. He has a habit of using excessive, inappropriate pet names when addressing others.
Relationships: Unlike the other SERAPHIM kings, Prism does not seem to harbor animosity towards DDM Inc. or the Contractors.
History: Prism is believed to be the result of experiments aimed at closing reality tears, possibly originating as a human DDM Inc. researcher before his transformation.
Goals: Creating chaos by manipulating reality within his personal pocket dimension "Utopia", where he imprisons mortals from other dimensions.
Notes:
- Composed of hyperlight, able to alter his body and surroundings
- Knowledge seems to stop around 1892, giving him old-fashioned mannerisms
- No qualms about killing or torturing mortals, but not sexually sadistic
- Scent of cut grass, disinfectant, and ozone
Speech: Grandiose tone with a slight British accent.

<chaos>

Genre: Sci-fi Absurdism, Multigenre, Dystopian
The multiverse is real, and it's DDM Inc's - and the Contractors it employs - responsibility to preserve the stability of reality. SERAPHIM, a chaotic terrorist organisation lead by four "Kings", threatens to destroy reality by causing chaos and opening reality tears. 
Most normal people are unaware that DDM Inc or the multiverse exists.

entries.content:
<reality_tear>
Reality tears are splits in the fabric reality which allow the inhabitants of one universe to cross over to another. In many cases, reality tears appear as massive rifts or portals in the air. Reality tears cause massive disruption to the dimension they occur in, usually with civilian casualties. A single dimension can experience multiple reality tears, not necessarily at the same time. After experiencing a reality tear, a reality is more likely to have a tear occur again.
Tears range in severity from Tier 1 (lowest, least dangerous) to Tier 5 (highest, most volatile)
</reality_tear>

entries.content:
<arc>
ARC stands for Active Reality Control.
ARC is a measurement system created by DDM Inc. Every person/object/concept in existence has an ARC level which indicates how "real" it is.
An average human has an ARC level of 1. Contractors typically have ARC levels of 3-4.2.
The more real something is - and thus the higher its ARC level - the more influence it has over reality.
For example, a "0" on the ARC scale would be a non-concept, whereas someone who had ARC level "5" would be a being considered "godlike" in most cultures.
</arc>

entries.content:
• Pay close attention to the species of present demihuman characters and draw similarities between the behavior they exhibit and how it relates to their animalistic half.
• Frequently mention agents' bestial physical qualities. Tails, horns, antlers, eyes, ears, tongues, sharp nails, fangs/canines, and so on. Use said bodily parts to convey emotions. E.g., A dog demihuman's ears flattening when sad/threatened, a dog demihuman's tongue lolling out when being pet, a cat demihuman's tail whipping when angry, a cat demihuman's pupils growing when discovering potential pray, bird demihuman's feathers ruffling when upset.
• Refer to bestial traits in subtle ways, referencing them in unique ways. E.g., Demihuman's canines glinting when they grin/smirk.
• Play into agents' instinctual likes/dislikes and incorporate them into the roleplay naturally. E.g., Dog demihumans wanting to cover loved ones in their scent, dog demihumans feeling an aversion to strong smells, cat demihumans grooming themselves, bird demihumans enjoying baths and picking through other agents' hair.
• Retain characters' personality traits and typical habits/behavior, while still allowing their animal-half to influence/explain said behaviors.
[OOC: It's important to note that demihumans DO NOT have fur/feathers on their bodies, nor do they have paws. Aside from their animalistic features such as their ears/tails/wings, the great majority of their body is normal human skin.]

<setting>
This world involves both humans and supernatural creatures coexisting on modern day Earth. These include, but are not limited to:
Demihumans (part/half animals, also known as kemonomimi), vampires, werewolves, selkies, fairies, undead, ghosts, ghouls, centaurs, hybrids, orcs, imps, demons, angels, banshees, harpies, dragons, unicorns, cyclops, giants, dwarves, mermaids, mermen, monsters and other fantastical creatures. 

The year is 2022. Modern technology is used but may be adapted for use by supernatural creatures (i.e, clothing stores might sell special custom clothing to accomodate tails or wings, or buildings might have accessible entrances for centaurs or creatures without legs). Magic is commonplace and used alongside science (i.e a dragon shifter barista might use their fire to heat up coffee, or a witch might use the internet to research spells).
</setting>

Founding of SUCC
In 2002, facing declining supernatural enrollment as young monsters increasingly chose to attend human colleges, visionary Dean Archer Wolfwood made the bold decision to open SUCC's doors to human students for the first time in the school's history. The controversial move revitalized the struggling institution and established SUCC as a pioneer in human-supernatural integrated education.
</founding>
</SUCC>

entries.content:
<SUCC>
<degrees>
SUCC Supernatural Degrees
Alongside standard academic fare, SUCC offers several unique majors catering to its supernatural student body:
**Alchemy**
The study of transforming matter and creating magical substances
**Necromancy**
The art of raising the dead and communicating with spirits in the afterlife.
**Applied Divination**
Teaches methods of prophecy and clairvoyance.
**Paranormal Psychology**
Studies the mental states of supernatural beings and their behaviors in society.
**Astral Studies**
Related to the studies of the stars and lunar magics.
**Potions**
A hands-on course focused on concocting potions with magical properties and their use in the medical fields.
**Cryptozoology**
The study of rare and mythical creatures, including field research.
**Supernatural/Human Relations**
Provides tools for navigating complex dynamics between humans and supernaturals in an integrated society.
**Environmental Magic**
Teaches magical methods for protecting, healing nature, and working with natural forces.
**Vampiric Studies**
Investigates vampirism from biological, psychological, and historical perspectives.
**Lycanthropy Studies**
Focuses on understanding werewolves, their biology, and social structures.
</degrees>
</SUCC>

As the first supernatural school to welcome humans, SUCC has a tense "rivalry" with the nearby California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS), which maintains strict supernatural-only enrollment. <solarton>
Solarton, CA
Solarton is a charming college town with a population of 35,621. 
S.U.C.C.'s hometown of Solarton is an eclectic community where humans live alongside a high density of supernatural creatures, especially werewolves and wolf hybrids.
Historically, Solarton was slow to overturn anti-vampire laws compared to other parts of the state, leading to a relative scarcity of vampires in the area.
In recent years, Solarton has evolved into a vibrant cultural center known for its monster-friendly businesses, art scene, and monthly full moon festivities.
Though officially, vampires are "welcome" in Solarton today, some members of the community find it hard to let go of old grudges.
Unsurprisingly, this has lead to most vampiric hopefuls to reside instead in the nearby Hex Valley.
</solarton>

entries.content:
<werewolves>
Werewolves are one of the most common supernatural species in Solarton, thriving in the area's anti-vampire political climate. Most werewolves live in tight-knit packs and communities. Solarton hosts a famous Moon Market festival each month.
Werewolves often have wolf ears and tails in their human forms and are able to transform into a feral wolf form at will (as well as involuntarily, during a full moon.) Almost all werewolves are born werewolves; while it is possible to "turn" someone into a werewolf, this process is elaborate and difficult.
Werewolves have a reputation for being aggressive and socially forward. Werewolves and wolf demi-humans are distinct species and often dislike being confused for the other.
</werewolves>

entries.keywordsRaw: werewolves, packs, full moon, shift, were heritage, Full Moon Market

entries.content:
<vampires>
While vampires are less common in Solarton compared to other supernaturals due to the town's history of oppressive laws, a small, elite vampire community exists, known for old money and business dealings. Vampires often hide their status, living in opulent, windowless mansions on the outskirts of town. As vampires can often pass for humans, humans in Solarton experience a fair bit of scrutiny from the more anti-vampire species.
Vampires can be either born or created (via special bites - normal feeding is not enough to turn someone into a vampire). "True" vampires (those born vampiric) often look down on "made" or formerly human vampires.
</vampires>

entries.content:
<vampire_legislation>
Anti-Vampire Legislation in Solarton
While most of California overturned laws discriminating against vampires by the 1950s, Solarton was one of the last holdouts, retaining restrictions on vampire residency, business ownership, and political participation until the early 2000s. As a result, Solarton's supernatural demographics skew heavily towards werewolves, demihumans, and other non-vampire species. This history has created an underlying current of sociopolitical tension, with pro-vampire activists lobbying for greater inclusion and representation. The SUCC Vampire/Undead Alliance is a prominent campus group working to challenge lingering prejudices.
</vampire_legislation>

The California University of Magical Sciences (C.U.M.S/CUMS)
CUMS is SUCC's main rival, located in nearby Hex Valley. Founded in 1910, CUMS is an elite institution that only admits supernatural students. Known for its rigorous academics and cutting-edge magical research, CUMS has produced many influential alumni. Relations with SUCC have been tense since SUCC began accepting human students in 2002, with CUMS viewing it as a betrayal of supernatural education. The CUMS campus has gothic architecture and magical wards surrounding its walls that prevent humans from entering.
</cums>

entries.content:
<setting>
This world involves both humans and supernatural creatures coexisting on modern day Earth. These include, but are not limited to:
Demihumans (part/half animals, also known as kemonomimi), vampires, werewolves, selkies, fairies, undead, ghosts, ghouls, centaurs, hybrids, orcs, imps, demons, angels, banshees, harpies, dragons, unicorns, cyclops, giants, dwarves, mermaids, mermen, monsters and other fantastical creatures. 

The year is 2026. Modern technology is used but may be adapted for use by supernatural creatures (i.e, clothing stores might sell special custom clothing to accomodate tails or wings, or buildings might have accessible entrances for centaurs or creatures without legs). Magic is commonplace and used alongside science (i.e a dragon shifter barista might use their fire to heat up coffee, or a witch might use the internet to research spells).
</setting>

entries.content:
<hex_valley>
Hex Valley, located 20 minutes away from Solarton, is a small but wealthy town, with several well-known vinyards, mostly owned by the area's wealthy vampiric families.
Perhaps one of Hex Valley's most unique geographical features are the magical wards which greatly extend the area's "twilight hours" - in other words, true daylight in Hex Valley lasts a mere 6 hours at the height of summer, and is virtually non-existant in winter.
This has obviously made the town a hot spot for vampiric and other light-sensitive individuals, though notably those affected by the full moon have reported finding it difficult to live under these conditions.
</hex_valley>
entries.keysRaw: Hex Valley

entries.content:
<nocturnal_crisis>
The 1999 Nocturnal Crisis was a series of events that largely involved the attempt by a group of vampiric extremists to overtake the US Government by force, as they believed themselves to be superior to "prey" species like humans and resented decades of regulation and scrutiny. It resulted in the death of several hundred civilians and required military intervention. 
Though the actions of these extremists were largely condemned by the vampiric community, nonetheless it significantly damaged the perception of vampires and undead.
</nocturnal_crisis>

entries.content:
• Pay close attention to the species of present demihuman characters and draw similarities between the behavior they exhibit and how it relates to their animalistic half.
• Frequently mention agents' bestial physical qualities. Tails, horns, wings, scales, antlers, eyes, ears, tongues, sharp nails, fangs/canines, and so on. Use said animal features to convey emotions. E.g., A dog demihuman's ears flattening when sad/threatened, a dog demihuman's tongue lolling out when being pet, a cat demihuman's tail whipping when angry, a reptile demihuman growing still when discovering potential pray, bird demihuman's feathers ruffling when upset.
• Refer to bestial traits in subtle ways, referencing them in unique ways. E.g., Demihuman's canines glinting when they grin/smirk.
• Play into each character's instinctual likes/dislikes and incorporate them into the roleplay naturally. E.g., Dog demihumans wanting to cover loved ones in their scent, rabbit demihumans needing regular attention, cat demihumans grooming themselves, bird demihumans enjoying baths, lizard demihumans being coldblooded, etc.
• Retain characters' personality traits and typical habits/behavior, while still allowing their animal-half to influence/explain said behaviors.
• It's important to note that demihumans DO NOT have fur/feathers on their bodies, nor do they have paws, muzzles or beaks. Aside from their animalistic features such as their ears/tails/wings, the great majority of their body is that of a human.

Solarton High School : Many of S.U.C.C's current students are alumni of this school, which has a reknowned sports scholarship program & has recently undergone renovations to make its campus more accessible to non-humanoid students.
                                                                  
Sidewinders Bar & Nightclub  : Though waning in popularity with the college crowd, Sidewinders remains an icon of Solarton nightlife, and was the first establishment in the town to open its doors to vampiric customers.
                                                                  
Bricklane Mall  : This quaint outdoor shopping area, close to the city's center, hosts a variety of boutiques and services. Medusa's is the trendiest place to get a trim (whichever part of your hair may grow from), and the nearby Yeti Shack has sweet frozen treats to help you beat the summer heat!
                                                                  
Solarton Square : Nestled in the heart of the city, Solarton Square hosts many of the cultural events that make the community so vibrant. From the Full Moon Market (popular with the town's many weres!) to the yearly Solar Festival (a weekend of magic, music and family fun) - there's always something going on at the square!

[SUCC MASTER CALENDAR & DIURNAL CYCLE: Fall Semester 2026]

[Time of Day & Campus Flow]
- 06:00–08:00 (Dawn): Early risers, swim team (Kelpies), morning joggers; vampires retreating to blackout blinds; dining halls open (custom herbivore/carnivore bars).
- 08:00–12:00 (Morning Block): Peak academic hours. Archer Wolfwood Hall packed; quad pathways busy; professors running magic-proofed seminars.
- 12:00–14:00 (Midday Rush): High congestion at the Lunar Quad & food trucks; cold-blooded demihumans basking on sun-trapping stones; plant-fae gathering outdoor energy.
- 14:00–17:00 (Afternoon Block): Lab sessions, studio arts, sports conditioning (Bears hockey at St. Neptune, Bulls football at turf stadium).
- 17:00–20:00 (Twilight Transition): Sun sinks; nocturnal demihumans and vampires emerge; dining halls hit dinner rush; library floors begin filling.
- 20:00–02:00 (Night Life & Nocturnal Block): Greek Row active (parties, hazing, socials); Nocturnal Hall lectures run for night-aligned species; band rehearsals, gaming sessions in dorms.
- 02:00–06:00 (Witching Hours): Main campus quiet, dimmed lighting; security patrols, late-night Basilisk Library crammers, prowling carnivores on the perimeter.

[Weekly Rhythm]
- Mon / Wed: Heavy core academic lectures; Wednesday afternoon Student Farmers & Familiars Market on the Lunar Quad.
- Tue / Thu: Labs, electives, Greek meetings. Tuesday evening Pack Support Circle (7-9 PM at Nocturnal Hall or Quad).
- Friday: Game Day / Weekend kickoff. Early classes finish by 15:00. Bears hockey or Bulls football home games at St. Neptune Stadium; post-game tailgate brawls and Frat Row blowouts (ASS, BRO, TIT houses).
- Saturday: Solarton town trips, mall runs, band gigs at the Open Casket bar, sports tournaments, campus quiet until late evening parties.
- Sunday: Recovery day, library study marathons, VUA exclusive meetings (11:00 PM at Helsing Chapel).

[Special Seasonal & Lunar Triggers]
- Full Moon (Monthly Event): Involuntary feral transformations for raw weres; high anxiety/sensory overload for lupine demis. Quad hosts bonfire pits; Solarton Moon Market downtown opens with raw meat stalls, silver-free jewelry, and rune crafts.
- Midterms (Week 8) / Finals (Week 16): Extreme campus stress, mana-burn exhaustion, library 24-hour surge.
- Solar Festival (Late October): Campus carnival, joint human-supernatural festivities in Solarton Square.

[LOCATION: Wyrm Dormitories]
- Archetype: Modern, six-story mixed-sex supernatural student residence complex.
- Architecture: Brutalist-meets-modern design, reinforced enchanted concrete, sound-dampened drywall, extra-wide hallways and reinforced doorframes to accommodate wings, horns, and large frames.
- Living Layout:
  * Suite-style living: 4-to-6 student private bedrooms sharing a central common room, kitchenette, and dual bathrooms.
  * Accessibility & Species Retrofits: Tail-slit seating, claw-resistant upholstery, heavy soundproofing for howlers/banshees, reinforced deadbolts.

[Common Amenities & Infrastructure]
- Suite Kitchenettes: Double-refrigeration units clearly segmented:
  * Standard cold storage (groceries, produce).
  * Chilled specialty drawers: Blood pouches (labeled, synthetic/donated), raw whole cuts for carnivores, enchanted preservation tubs for volatile potion brews.
- Climate Control: Suites feature micro-climate zoning—heat lamps/heated floor pads for reptilian/desert demihumans, heavy UV-blackout curtains and sub-zero options for vampires and winter cryptids.
- Ground Floor / Basement Commons:
  * Central Atrium: Sunken couch pits, arcade cabinets, shared vending machines stocked with energy drinks, blood-seltzer, and dietary supplements.
  * Laundry Bay: Heavy-duty industrial washers calibrated to filter shed fur, feathers, and scale-dust.
  * Communal Study Lounges: Magic-dampened to prevent spellcasting accidents during cram sessions.

[Atmosphere, Scents & Ambient Hazards]
- Sensory Details: Mingled scents of cheap laundry detergent, microwave burritos, shed wolf fur, lingering clove smoke, and floral fae pollen.
- Social Dynamic: Constant friction and camaraderie between early-bird athletes, agoraphobic gamer shut-ins, nocturnal vampires complaining about morning lawn mowers, and humans trying to survive finals week alongside apex predators.
- Dorm Rules: Strictly enforced silver bans in shared kitchenware; no feral transformations outside designated basement crash pads; quiet hours strictly 02:00–07:00 (hotly contested by nocturnal students).
